author: karpathy
text: The "move fast & fix stuff until it compiles then it's probably fine" approach is inadequate when each bug silently subtracts 2% accuracy.

author: karpathy
text: To get neural nets to work one must be super-OCD about details. With bugs nets will train (they "want" to work), but work silently worse.

author: karpathy
text: Ideally never absorb information without predicting it first. Then you can update both 1) your knowledge but also 2) your generative model.
